nuggets.text: Lane Kiffin was the youngest head coach in modern NFL history when the Raiders hired him at age 31.
Sam Leavitt ran for 113 yards and two touchdowns and threw for 230 more in his LSU debut against Clemson.
Sam Leavitt was Oregon's Gatorade Football Player of the Year before stops at Michigan State and Arizona State.
Sam Leavitt's brother, Dallin Leavitt, played in the NFL.
The Tigers' opener against Clemson kicked off nearly two hours late after a downpour and a lightning delay.
The Tigers' 1988 crowd against Auburn got so loud that a campus seismograph registered it as an earthquake.
The Tigers' first Mike the Tiger was bought from the Little Rock Zoo with 25 cents from each LSU student, $750 in all.
Tiger Stadium still uses old-style H goalposts instead of the Y-shaped kind most schools use today.
Tiger Stadium marks its yard lines every five yards, not just every 10 like most football fields.
Winston Watkins Jr., an Ole Miss transfer, caught a 32-yard touchdown in the Tigers' 51-10 win over Clemson.
